name: Keeper and the Wild Nursery
shortDescription: Keeper and his wildlife team care for orphaned animals, helping Nomsa, Ndiwa, Ambia and three hungry cheetah cubs grow strong enough to return to the wild.
longDescription: Keeper runs a special nursery for orphaned wild animals. After helping young Nomsa regain her strength, the team receives five-day-old elephant Ndiwa by helicopter, cares for weak young giraffe Ambia and welcomes three hungry cheetah cubs named Kopi, Kepi and Keji. As feeding challenges, nursery mischief and a powerful storm test the team, Nomsa becomes a calming presence for the younger animals. Months later, Keeper faces the bittersweet moment every wildlife rescuer hopes for: opening the gate so a recovered animal can return home to the wild.

attribution.author: Ursula Nafula and Nina Orange
attribution.adaptationNote: Adapted for animation by Panda Kids Club as Keeper and the Wild Nursery. Changes were made, including an expanded rescue storyline, nursery storm sequence, additional character interactions and a release ending.
